notes: Full active domain; holes absent; Keep ignored. Plane stress, small strain. Stress in domain axes, force/length^2; VM is max of 4 Gauss points per cell. Point loads and sharp restraints can create mesh-dependent stress peaks.

loading_notes: Distributed loads on fixed DOFs contribute to reactions; nodal point loads in constrained directions remain rejected.
Surface loads act on preserved grid facets, not an evolving CAD boundary.
Self-weight optimization is experimental: low-density SIMP parasitic effects and mesh dependence require final-shape verification.

material.name: Structural steel / S235 reference
material.yield_scope: S235 hot-rolled stock at thickness <= 16 mm only; confirm product certificate.
notes: Yield is not automatically an allowable design stress.
Stock thickness must be declared to enable the reference yield comparison.
Feature-size erosion is diagnostic only; no certified minimum wall or tool-access check.
Thresholded geometry requires FEM reanalysis; no smoothing is applied.

design_limits.note: Numerical limits on this model, not code compliance. Relaxed design stress is not final-shape stress.
